provenanceNote: Renamed from se-dates-leap-day-valid, which would now be a lie: the 1800 floor rejects the year 0012. The coverage is intact, and the failure member is what preserves it. The floor is checked after the date, so reaching implausible-birth-date proves isRealDate() accepted 29 February 0012 as a real leap day — had it not, this would report impossible-date instead. The distinction between the two members is doing the work. Century "00" has never been issued by Skatteverket, so no bearer can exist.

Year 0000 is inside the century-"00" carve-out (never issued by Skatteverket), so a constructed case is safe here regardless of outcome. It exercises PHP checkdate()'s year floor (1-32767) against JavaScript's Date, which has none and used to accept year 0 — see docs/open-threads.md §3.13 for the carve-out and the final review's Important 3 for the divergence this closes.
